hl.description: Parameter defines the language to use for the Google Trends Trending Now search. It's a two or three-letter language code. Head to the Google languages page for a full list of supported Google languages.

geo.description: Parameter defines the location from where you want the search to originate. It defaults to `US` (activated when the value of `geo` parameter is not set or empty). Head to the Google Trends Trending Now Locations for a full list of supported locations.

category_id.description: Parameter allows results to be filtered by a specific category. E.g. `category_id`:`18` will return only results from the "Technology" category. Head to the Google Trends Trending Now Categories for the full list of supported categories.

only_active.description: Parameter filters results to only include those that are currently active.

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

# Google Trends Trending Now

List searches trending right now on Google in a country, with search volume, growth, start time and related queries, filtered by category and time window.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/google/trends-trending-now" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"geo": "US"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `hours` | string | No | Parameter defines the number of past hours to retrieve the results for. It defaults to `24` (Past 24 hours). It can be set to: -`4` (Past 4 hours) -`24` (Past 24 hours) -`48` (Past 48 hours) -`168` (Past 7 days). |
| `category_id` | string | No | Parameter allows results to be filtered by a specific category. E.g. `category_id`:`18` will return only results from the "Technology" category. Head to the Google Trends Trending Now Categories for the full list of supported categorie |
| `only_active` | string | No | Parameter filters results to only include those that are currently active. |
| `hl` | string | No | Parameter defines the language to use for the Google Trends Trending Now search. It's a two or three-letter language code. (e.g., `en` for English, `es` for Spanish, or `fr` for French), optionally followed by a two-letter or three-digit re |
| `json_restrictor` | string | No | Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details. |
